content: DoH JSON API (Cloudflare/Google) returns HTTP 2xx for any valid DNS response including NXDOMAIN/SERVFAIL - the actual result is in the JSON body's Status field (RCODE), not the HTTP status code, so clients must parse Status separately from HTTP success. No CORS headers by default on some resolvers/plain fetch from browser JS to a foreign-origin DoH endpoint requires the resolver to send Access-Control-Allow-Origin; Cloudflare's 1.1.1.1 JSON endpoint supports CORS, but public DoH JSON APIs are not RFC-standardized across providers, so behavior (e.g. TXT record quoting) can differ.
